add_vlpart_config: add VLPart configuration defaults to a detectron2 CfgNode config object
configure_dino_model: configure DINO self-supervised model settings including stride, layer, threshold, and facet for feature extraction
setup_open_vocabulary_classifier: setup open-vocabulary classifier with zero-shot weights, normalization temperature, and federated loss options
configure_multi_dataset_dataloader: configure multi-dataset dataloader with per-dataset batch sizes, input scales, and annotation types
enable_caption_loss_training: enable caption data training with text encoder type, batch ratio, and caption loss weight settings
